title.narrative: Greening Justice - criminal law protection of the environment

description.narrative:
The contribution's objective is, in short, an enhanced criminal law response to violations of environmental rules by strengthened public prosecutors and increased cooperation between the stakeholders in the criminal proceedings.
The contribution aims to achieve this by the following: Strengthening prosecutors' skills and fostering cooperation among all stakeholders in criminal proceedings will boost environmental protection. Enhanced prosecutorial expertise will enable more effective investigation and prosecution of environmental crimes, leading to greater accountability and deterrence. Streamlined legal processes through collaboration will reduce delays, ensuring swifter justice outcomes and leaving fewer opportunities for offenders.
As a result of the project's efforts to enhance the capacity of public prosecutors and foster collaboration among stakeholders, there is an expected increase in the prosecution of environmental criminal offenses. Furthermore, through improved coordination and communication among stakeholders, including civil society, there should be greater participation in decision-making processes related to environmental protection. This increased engagement fosters transparency and accountability, ultimately leading to better-informed policies and practices. In the end, the project's focus on education, awareness-raising, and advocacy will contribute to a more informed public and heightened awareness and transparency of environmental crimes and their consequences. This collaborative approach will send a strong deterrent message, promoting compliance with environmental regulations and safeguarding the environment. Moreover, by creating an environment that is enabling for environmental human rights defenders, there should be an improved criminal justice response to corruption in environmental cases.

Projektet syftar till att förbättra de allmänna åklagarnas kapacitet att effektivt åtala miljöbrott. För att uppnå detta antar projektet en holistisk strategi som involverar intressenter från den offentliga och privata sektorn, rättsväsendet, brottsbekämpning, miljöskyddsorgan, media och det civila samhället. Projektet kommer att förbättra samordningen och kommunikationen mellan intressenter, främja samhällets egenmakt, öka allmänhetens medvetenhet och främja deltagande beslutsfattande. Eftersom miljöbrott är kopplade till korruption kommer projektet också att utveckla metoder för att bedöma korruption, ta fram rekommendationer för att hantera korruptionsrisker och skydda miljöaktivister och visselblåsare genom rättshjälp.

The project aims to improve the capacity of public prosecutors to effectively prosecute environmental crimes. To achieve this, the project adopts a holistic approach involving stakeholders from the public and private sectors, judiciary, law enforcement, environmental protection agencies, media and civil society. Project will improve coordination and communication among stakeholders, foster community empowerment, increase public awareness and promote participatory decision-making. Recognizing the interconnections of environmental crimes with corruption, Project will also develop methodologies for assessing corruption, developing recommendations to address corruption risks and protecting environmental activists and whistle-blowers through legal aid.
The activity period of the contribution commenced on the 1 January 2025. The first set of results will therefore be published following the receipt of the first project reporting.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
